status_task.sql:
CREATE TABLE status_task (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_status_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status_log_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	is_completed BOOLEAN, 
	photo_path VARCHAR(500), 
	description TEXT, 
	sort INTEGER, 
	create_time DATETIME, 
	update_time DATETIME, thumb_photo_path TEXT COMMENT '缩略图路径，多张缩略图路径以逗号分隔', 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_status_id) REFERENCES order_status (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(status_log_id) REFERENCES order_status_log (id)
)

system_configs.sql:
CREATE TABLE system_configs (
	"key" TEXT NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT, 
	description TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

task.sql:
CREATE TABLE task (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	author_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	completion_note TEXT, 
	completion_image_url VARCHAR(500), 
	todo_image_url VARCHAR(500), 
	expected_date VARCHAR(10), 
	background_color VARCHAR(20), 
	like_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

task_comment.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_comment (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(100), 
	author_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	deleted_by VARCHAR(100), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES task (id)
)

task_history.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_history (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	modified_by VARCHAR(100), 
	modified_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES task (id)
)

task_like.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_like (
	task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (task_id, user_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_task_user_like UNIQUE (task_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES task (id)
)

task_media_file.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_media_file (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            status_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            file_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
            file_format VARCHAR(20),
            file_size BIGINT,
            file_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
            thumb_path VARCHAR(500),
            file_name VARCHAR(200),
            duration INTEGER,
            upload_time DATETIME,
            sort INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            is_deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0,
            FOREIGN KEY (status_task_id) REFERENCES status_task (id)
        )

task_visibility.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_visibility (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	task_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	visibility_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	visibility_value VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(task_id) REFERENCES task (id)
)

todo.sql:
CREATE TABLE todo (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	author_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	image_url VARCHAR(500), 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	completion_note TEXT, 
	completion_image_url VARCHAR(500), 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

todo_message.sql:
CREATE TABLE todo_message (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	todo_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	author_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, image_url VARCHAR(500), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(todo_id) REFERENCES todo (id)
)

todo_message_read.sql:
CREATE TABLE todo_message_read (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	todo_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	last_read_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_todo_message_read_user_todo UNIQUE (todo_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(todo_id) REFERENCES todo (id)
)

todo_visibility.sql:
CREATE TABLE todo_visibility (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	todo_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_todo_visibility UNIQUE (todo_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(todo_id) REFERENCES todo (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

totp_user.sql:
CREATE TABLE totp_user (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	emp_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	totp_secret VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	create_time DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (emp_id)
)

user.sql:
CREATE TABLE user (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username), 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES role (id)
)

user_role.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_role (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	employee_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	role_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES role (id)
)

videos.sql:
CREATE TABLE videos (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        tags VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        machine_id TEXT NULL DEFAULT '',
        remark TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        search_field TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        uploader VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        original_path VARCHAR(500) NULL,
        thumbnail_path VARCHAR(500) NULL,
        compressed_path VARCHAR(500) NULL,
        original_width INTEGER NULL DEFAULT 0,
        original_height INTEGER NULL DEFAULT 0,
        duration FLOAT NULL DEFAULT 0.0,
        file_size BIGINT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        compress_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        upload_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    , delete_time DATETIME, delete_operator VARCHAR(100))

warehouse_items.sql:
CREATE TABLE warehouse_items (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	map_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	x_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	y_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	length_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	width_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	height_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rotation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_group VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	stocked_date DATE, 
	stocked_by VARCHAR(20), 
	remark TEXT, 
	shipped_date DATE, 
	shipped_at DATETIME, 
	shipped_by VARCHAR(20), 
	shipped_remark TEXT, 
	is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(map_id) REFERENCES warehouse_maps (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(stocked_by) REFERENCES "Employee" (emp_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(shipped_by) REFERENCES "Employee" (emp_id)
)

warehouse_maps.sql:
CREATE TABLE warehouse_maps (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	width_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	length_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	grid_columns INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	grid_rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	active INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

warehouse_objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE warehouse_objects (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	map_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	x_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	y_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	length_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	width_mm INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rotation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	show_text INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pattern VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	blocks_cargo INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(map_id) REFERENCES warehouse_maps (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
